newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins down ahead of Friday US figures.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins down ahead of Friday US figures.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds eased in thin trading on Thursday on inflationary fears ahead of Friday's U.S. statistics data and dealers' worries over a further interest rate hike, dealers said.
U.S. retail sales and producer prices figures for March are due on Friday at 1230 GMT. MinFins closely track Brady Bonds and other emerging market debt.
"Prices are going down as there is no reason to go up at the moment," one dealer said. "U.S. Treasuries eased yesterday, followed by Bradys."
Dealers said Western traders were mainly seen selling But volumes traded were not big as the market paused for breath ahead of the U.S. data.
"People are nervous ahead of Friday's figures," a Moscow Narodny Bank dealer said. "The market is drifting down and what was bid side in the morning became offer side in the afternoon."
